text: FVLND[p,mu,n,nb] denotes the positive component in the lightcone decomposition of the Lorentz vector p^{\mu } along the vectors n and nb in \(D\) dimensions. It corresponds to \(\frac{1}{2} n^{\mu} (p \cdot \bar{n})\).
